name: operationSearch
label: Find operations
help: Words that fill the Endpoint ID list, for example `verify an email`. Leave empty to list verified endpoints. Only used to fill the list; the module does not send it.

name: endpointId
label: Endpoint ID
help: Pick an endpoint, or type or map an endpoint ID or a job written as `job:<job id>`, for example `job:people.email.find`. A job lets looot pick the provider.

name: inputMode
label: Input

nested.name: input
nested.label: Input (JSON)
nested.help: The input object as JSON text, for example `{"email": "jane.doe@example.com"}`. The module parses it and sends an object. Get an operation lists the field names. Use this when an agent or an earlier module builds the input.

help: JSON takes any input. Fields of the selected operation shows one field per input of the Endpoint ID, read from looot.

name: fallback
label: Try other providers
help: When the first provider finds nothing, looot tries the next provider of the same job. Only the attempts that ran are charged. Works with job IDs only.

name: maxCostUsd
label: Max cost (USD)
help: The most this module may spend across all providers it tries, for example `0.1`. Leave empty for the default cap. Used only when Try other providers is on.

name: wait
label: Wait (seconds)
help: How long to wait for the result, from 0 to 30. A run that takes longer comes back with the status `queued` or `running`; read it later with Get a run.

name: idempotencyKey
label: Idempotency key
help: The same key with the same input never pays twice. Leave empty and the module builds one from the input and the date.
